answer: An imaging market handling prism tests, pearl photos and ivory artifact scans can allocate scarce subsidized compute by burn tickets. Before a future random beacon is revealed, each bidder destroys credits and commits a job request. Draw slots with weight proportional to credits burned; mark every burn output used once and give no weight for account count. Splitting ten credits across a thousand keys leaves the same total chance as one key. A farmer must destroy more capital to gain more slots. This needs unpredictable draws and no refund or per-identity bonus.
